q: Which part of a metric is 'out of what population'?
why: The denominator is the bottom of the fraction.

q: Why start Android checkout conversion at the payment screen?
o: It isolates the checkout step itself
It's the only data we have
why: Starting at app open would mix the checkout step with everything before it.

q: A purchase refunded a week later still counts as a completed checkout in most teams' conversion metric.
why: Most teams keep it and track refunds separately.

q: What does the two-person test ask?
o: Do two teams agree the metric matters?
Could two people, given only the spec, compute the same number?
Did two analysts review the query?
Is the metric in two dashboards?
why: If two careful analysts could get different results, the spec has a hole.

q: Leaving internal test accounts in a metric doesn't matter much.
why: Myth. Leave them in and you're measuring your own QA team.
